annotation.title_clean: The Bletchley Declaration by Countries Attending the AI Safety Summit, 1-2 November 2023
annotation.title_en: The Bletchley Declaration by Countries Attending the AI Safety Summit, 1-2 November 2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UK Government (Prime Minister's Office, FCDO, DSIT) on behalf of AI Safety Summit participating countries
annotation.summary_en: Joint declaration by 28 countries and the EU at the 2023 UK AI Safety Summit. It recognises opportunities and risks of AI, especially frontier AI, and commits signatories to international cooperation, shared scientific understanding of risks, risk-based policies, safety testing and transparency by frontier developers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Affirms AI should be safe, human-centric, trustworthy and responsible
Identifies frontier AI risks including cybersecurity, biotechnology and disinformation
Frontier developers bear particular responsibility for safety testing and evaluation
Commits to shared scientific understanding and an international research network on frontier AI safety
Supports pro-innovation, proportionate, risk-based national approaches and future summits
